title: Desktop controls (keyboard+mouse, pointer lock, rebinding, discoverability)
findings: BOOT CONFIRMED before work: node tools/harness/smoke.mjs passes 6/6 (chromium 141, SwiftShader).

tools/journey/gamepad-shim.mjs EXISTS and is real (14.4 KB) — injects at the navigator.getGamepads() seam with x2s-standard / x2s-hid-dualsense / xbox-standard presets, dispatches real GamepadEvents, has --self-test. NOT phantom. tools/journey/journey-run.mjs IS phantom — mine to write.

DEFECT (desktop, hard): game/src/input/bindings.js binds spell_cycle:['KeyR'] and heavy:['KeyR','Mouse3']. buildControlMap() iterates in key order so spell_cycle OVERWRITES heavy on KeyR — the heavy attack is unreachable on its normative primary key. RI-JRN03 M-K1 hard fail.
DEFECT (pad, HF1): GAMEPAD_BINDINGS does not bind sprint, swap_left or swap_right at all. RI-JRN04 G1/M-P1 hard fail (any of the fourteen unbound).

DEFECT (pad): block=6(LT) and parry=4(LB) are SWAPPED vs RI-JRN04 §C (block must be LB=4 held, parry LT=6). jump on 3(Y) not 10(L3); two_hand on 8(Back) which §C reserves for journal; lock_on on 10(L3) not 11(R3).
DEFECT (pad, HF8): triggers read `b.pressed || b.value > 0.5` — no T_fire 0.35 / T_release 0.20 hysteresis, no T_full 0.85 charge gate. RI-JRN04 G0 says reading .pressed on a trigger is a defect.
DEFECT (pad, HF-most-load-bearing): no roll/sprint 12-frame tap/hold discriminator on button 1. roll is a plain discrete; sprint has no pad control at all.

DEFECT (pad, HF2): no mapping!=='standard' path. pushGamepadState() hard-codes mapping:'standard' and boolean-only buttons, so it cannot even express the X2s' DualSense-like HID mode. No pad-quirks.json, no calibration sequence.
DEFECT (pad lifecycle): no gamepadconnected/gamepaddisconnected listeners anywhere. Disconnect is only noticed at the next poll; L6 (two pads) takes the first connected, not the most recently active.

ABSENT ENTIRELY: touch input (RI-JRN04 §G, 14 actions, T1-T10) — zero touch code in the tree. Rebinding model (RI-JRN03 §E RB1-RB11) — zero. Mobile viewport/orientation/safe-area (§F H1-H12) — game/index.html uses 100vh (H4 bans it, `RI-JRN04` How-we-lose #8) and has no env(safe-area-inset-*) use.
HARNESS GAPS: A-JRN4 (viewport/orientation/safe-area control) and A-JRN12 (keyboard-layout emulation) are declared absent by api.js's own capability report. M-P16..M-P19 and M-K2 need them.

CORPUS CONFLICT: RI-JRN04 §D sets the right-stick inner deadzone at 0.10 and curve m'^2.0; the shipped shapeLookStick() implements RI-CAM02 §A's 0.15/0.95/quadratic. RI-JRN04's own header cedes camera behaviour to RI-CAM02 but claims the stick transform (deadzone, curve, sensitivity). Recorded as corpus debt; see report.

tools/journey/journey-run.mjs LANDED at 07:09 from the tool builder (50 KB) with --journey jrn03-desktop/jrn04-pad, --layouts, --gamepad, --dpr, --pointer, --self-test, and it reads harness_amendments_absent from getCapabilityReport(). I did NOT write it.

A-JRN4 was absent; I implemented it (game/src/input/viewport.js + __HARNESS.setViewport/getViewport) and updated api.js's capability report. A-JRN2 already worked via __HARNESS.gamepad(); I widened pushGamepadState() to carry a real `mapping` string and per-button `.value` so a non-standard descriptor can reach the translation layer.

SHARED-TREE HAZARD (not mine): the build STOPPED BOOTING at 07:12 with `QuestBook: Q-MAIN-10 consequences name quest Q-MAIN-11, which does not exist` from the main-quest builder's in-flight game/data/quests/mainline-act2.json. QuestBook load is fail-loud by design, so this blocks every browser measurement in the tree until they land act3. Boot was confirmed green before my work started.
Another agent's in-flight commit (9d2d981) absorbed my files; I did not commit.
